Flashcard Maker

Make digital flashcards: add question/answer cards, study with flip mode, shuffle, and track what you know — saved on this device.

📖 How to use

  1. Add flashcards with a front and back.
  2. Press Study deck to enter flip mode.
  3. Tap the card to flip, mark Known or Still learning, and track progress.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I use it?

Add cards with a front (question) and back (answer), then press Study to flip through them one at a time.

Are my cards saved?

Yes — your deck is saved in the browser's localStorage and restored when you return.

Can I shuffle the deck?

Press Shuffle deck in study mode to randomize the card order.

How does progress tracking work?

Mark cards as Known or Still learning while studying; the progress bar shows how much of the deck you know.

Is this private?

Yes — everything stays in your browser.
